name: Rendering-based calibration for depth selection
definition: A post-selection refinement step that evaluates candidate depth changes by rendering held-out calibration views to account for visibility, Gaussian overlap, and alpha-compositing interactions which are not explicitly modeled by the local proxy.
summary: Rendering-based calibration is a post-selection refinement that evaluates depth changes by rendering held-out views to account for visibility and compositing interactions ignored by local proxies.
